sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:54476
Court No. - 14

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9289 of 2023
Applicant :- Ashish Kumar @ Ashish Raidas
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Smriti
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed by the State is taken on record.

2. Heard Ms. Seema Kashyap holding brief of Ms. Smriti, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

This bail second application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Ashish Kumar @ Ashish Raidas for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.154 of 2019, under Section 376 I.P.C. and Section 67-A of I.T. Act, Police Station Asoha, District Unnao, during trial as his first bail application has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 20.01.2021 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.5410 of 2020, on merits.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed Ashish Kumar @ Ashish Raidas vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

5. It is further submitted that first bail application of the applicant was rejected in the year 2021,
however, after rejection of first bail application of the applicant, statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the trial court, wherein she has not supported the story of the prosecution and categorically stated that she was not raped by the applicant.

6. It is also submitted that the prosecutrix has also disowned her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and have categorically stated that the statement under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. was given under the pressure of the police and her mother.

It is vehemently submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that it is a case, where the prosecutrix/victim was the only evidence of the crime as no abnormality was found in the medical examination report of the prosecutrix and since she has chosen not to support the prosecution, the conviction of the applicant would be a remote possibility.
7. It is next submitted that applicant is in jail in this case since 17.05.2020 and he is not having any criminal history, charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
8.

Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that first bail application of the applicant has been rejected on merits and there is no new ground in favour of the applicant, on the basis of which facility of bail may be extended to the applicant, thus he is not entitled to be released on bail.
9.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that the prosecutrix was aged about 16 years at the date and time of the incident.

She has supported the version of the F.I.R. in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. and it is on that basis, first bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 20.01.2021 and now the statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the trial court, wherein she has chosen to become hostile and did not support the factum of rape or sexual assault.

It has been stated by the prosecutrix before the trial court that no rape has been committed by the applicant on her and she has also disowned her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.

It is in this background, it is submitted with considerable force by learned counsel for the applicant that since no abnormality has been found in the medical examination of the prosecutrix and she has chosen to become hostile, the conviction of the applicant would not be possible.

Having regard to the evidence of the prosecutrix and keeping in view the evidence of the prosecutrix recorded before the trial court, in the considered opinion of this Court, there is substantial change in circumstance since rejection of his first bail application.
Charge-sheet in this case has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail in this case since 17.05.2020 without any previous criminal history.
The presence of the applicant could be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

10. Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the Ashish Kumar @ Ashish Raidas vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108853586/
2 learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The second bail application moved by applicant is thus allowed.

11. Let the accused/applicant- Ashish Kumar @ Ashish Raidas involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
12. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
13. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
14. Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression of this Court on the merits of the case.

Order Date :- 17.8.2023 Anupam S/-
